score: discharge-relative hourly SOFA over the final seven ICU days

adaptations.description: Index 0 is (outtime-1h,outtime], increasing backward to at most 167; the earliest interval is partial for stays whose duration is not an integer number of hours.
A reverse trajectory is undefined without raw ICU outtime. Such stays are counted and excluded rather than assigned an invented discharge time.
All eligible stays are scored without outcome filtering, then raw admissions death time and hospital expiry status are attached for dead/alive analyses.
Nullable rolling components are retained while the upstream zero-filled total is preserved.
Adds the omitted leading segment where an earliest partial interval enters a 24-row frame, and scores only positive vasoactive rates from episodes lasting at least one hour.

preserved_context: All earlier selected-stay urine-output rows are staged through outtime so the urine-rate LAG predecessor is preserved.
Every exported rolling interval is exactly (endtime-24h,endtime].
